name: Ti5robot T170C V2.0
summary: A wheeled humanoid with two 7-DOF industrial force-controlled arms, a 3-DOF waist and folding 2-DOF legs on a differential-drive base, aimed at factory material handling, assembly and inspection.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller or distributor found; Ti5robot lists only Shanghai sales contacts (sales@ti5robot.com).

specs.label: Active DOF
specs.quote: T170C-V2.0 系列产品具备 22 个主动自由度（不包含底盘与灵巧手自由度）

specs.label: DOF per arm
specs.quote: 机器人搭载了两条工业级双臂，每条手臂具备 7 个自由度。

specs.label: Waist / leg DOF
specs.quote: 机器人腰部为 3 自由度设计，腿部为 2 自由度折叠设计。

specs.label: Battery
specs.conditions: auto-docking supported for 24/7 work with charging breaks

specs.label: Max obstacle height
specs.quote: 机器人底盘最大越障高度 5mm

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 360° camera ring, front and rear lidar, ultrasonic ring, six-axis force sensors
specs.quote: 机器人搭载了多目相机组成 360° 全景视频，搭配底盘前后的激光雷达，及围绕底盘一圈的超声波雷达

capabilities.sdk: SDK and API for secondary development
notes: Differential-drive chassis clears only 5 mm steps, so it is for flat indoor floors.
Low-latency full-DOF teleoperation and data-collection kits are optional extras.
Ti5robot's dual-arm module sold for its humanoids is rated 6 kg per arm at the flange ('单臂额定负载（末端法兰）6kg'), but the T170C page does not state its own arm payload.
Ti5robot's factory-handling solution claims dual-arm transfer of loads up to 40 kg; the page does not tie this figure to the T170C.
